requirements.title: Current checkout and dirty-file ownership recorded
requirements.acceptance: Capture current ref/content IDs, active audit fixes and installed buyables; pinned ref is not restored.

requirements.title: Active authority supersedes direct-spend model
requirements.acceptance: Update current instructions/ADRs; no conflicting active no-income, automatic EX, debit-on-start or round-locked-art rules.

requirements.title: All old audit findings reconciled
requirements.acceptance: Every PP ID retained with actual disposition; no paper-only resolved status.

requirements.title: Every live product and move mapped
requirements.acceptance: Inventory exact runtime IDs including local additions; baseline26 and proposed38 remain distinct.

requirements.title: EX has explicit buy-period price and license
requirements.acceptance: Eight baseline EX families no longer base-owned; each price in item data, activation cost zero.

requirements.title: Super permit bought and chosen every round
requirements.acceptance: Zero/one art and one use per round; no mandatory match-locked free art.

requirements.title: Mixed cart constraints data-driven
requirements.acceptance: One each technique slot, max2EX/max1super,2400 budget, bank limit, conflicts and replacements.

requirements.title: Catalog distinguishes implemented from proposed
requirements.acceptance: No unbuilt install/barrier sold as working; current implemented features preserved.

requirements.title: New content/schema identity
requirements.acceptance: Replay/network and validation versions explicitly incompatible where semantics changed.

requirements.title: Atomic both-player shop commit
requirements.acceptance: Invalid second plan leaves BOTH banks and entitlements unchanged.

requirements.title: Duplicate commits idempotent and conflicts rejected
requirements.acceptance: Same key/payload charges once; altered payload/key conflicts fail closed.

requirements.title: No combat bank writes or affordability checks
requirements.acceptance: Production trace and code review prove fixed bank through fight and licenses work at zero bank.

requirements.title: Repeatable EX ownership correct
requirements.acceptance: Own selected family repeats only after legal recovery, not owned families remain locked even at cap.

requirements.title: Locked intent does not downgrade
requirements.acceptance: Explicit EX/super syntax recognized before access filter; no fallback normal/special or release-edge attack.

requirements.title: Super use commits exactly once
requirements.acceptance: Illegal/buffered input consumes none; legal startup consumes1; whiff/block/parry/interrupt do not restore.

requirements.title: Ordinary free kit preserved
requirements.acceptance: All ordinary moves/defense work without purchases, subject to intentional optional replacements.

requirements.title: Round expiry and rematch reset
requirements.acceptance: Both sides lose licenses/unused permit at next round; bank persists; rematch resets bank.

requirements.title: Charge and cancel legality preserved
requirements.acceptance: Purchase does not invent charge, automatic execution, invulnerability or unbounded EX chains.

requirements.title: Pre-contact immutable provenance
requirements.acceptance: Grounded/air/startup/combo/owner/root facts are captured before applied launches/state clearing.

requirements.title: Counter-hit definition tested
requirements.acceptance: Only actual eligible damaging direct opener interrupting offensive startup; no passive feint/recovery/juggle awards.

requirements.title: Anti-air definition tested
requirements.acceptance: Grounded nonprejump direct opener vs voluntary-air target; no post-launch, air-to-air/projectile/throw bonus.

requirements.title: Perfect parry timing deterministic
requirements.acceptance: Eligible ages0/1 grant; age2 still ordinary successful parry if within normal window.

requirements.title: Frozen-edge parry rule explicit
requirements.acceptance: Deferred edge from freeze can defend under normal rules but does not gain free perfect bonus on thaw.

requirements.title: Multihit and reflection provenance
requirements.acceptance: Root identities survive objects/branches/reflection; own reflected projectile and automatic counters do not earn perfect.

requirements.title: Simultaneous and lethal contacts fair
requirements.acceptance: Accepted contact arbitration then rewards, mirrored seat traces and terminal tick award behavior.

requirements.title: Pending awards cannot be spent
requirements.acceptance: Bank fixed during combat; earned50/75/100 shown as next-shop only.

requirements.title: Overlapping awards resolved once
requirements.acceptance: AA+CH contact pays75; no capped-highest fallback; same root never earns again.

requirements.title: Per-category and aggregate caps
requirements.acceptance: Two paid per category,300 total, truthful partial-cap receipts.

requirements.title: Duplicates and canonical order
requirements.acceptance: Reward replay/resimulation never doubles income; conflicting IDs fail in production fact ingestion.

requirements.title: Confirmed payout and clipping
requirements.acceptance: No predicted deposits; old-tier result grant first, then skill grant, total cap and clipping reported.

requirements.title: Draw/abort/final results defined
requirements.acceptance: Draw grants900+eligible skill; abort no unresolved payout; terminal funds not comeback liquidity.

requirements.title: No passive/farming shortcuts
requirements.acceptance: No ordinary hit/block/normal-parry/whiff/XP/interest revenue; bounded repeat-feeding tests.

requirements.title: Complete authoritative snapshot
requirements.acceptance: Bank/license/uses/reward roots/counts/receipts/parry clocks roundtrip and hash across native code.

requirements.title: Corrected use and reward roll back
requirements.acceptance: False super/reward disappears after correction without compensating cash or duplicate sound.

requirements.title: Commit/reveal includes cart and art
requirements.acceptance: Price/content/eligibility validated on both peers; no client-declared bonus packet.

requirements.title: Legacy replays handled honestly
requirements.acceptance: Explicit version refusal or genuine legacy interpreter; originals never rewritten.

requirements.title: Actual independent process match
requirements.acceptance: Two processes complete multi-round match under delay/jitter/loss/duplicate/reorder matrix.

requirements.title: Bounded memory and malformed payloads
requirements.acceptance: Long match/hostile cart and input fuzz retains bounded collections and exact deterministic result.

requirements.title: Registry shop cards and navigation
requirements.acceptance: EX/super purchase input and prices reflect actual data; all controller paths usable.

requirements.title: Valid timeout and ready flow
requirements.acceptance: Visible last-valid cart used on timeout; no silent full wipe or unauthorized other-seat edits.

requirements.title: Opponent-history-driven preparation
requirements.acceptance: Prior revealed kit and objective public facts available, no invented behavior inference.

requirements.title: Honest combat HUD

requirements.title: Result receipt complete

requirements.title: Bots purchase executable kits
